 A.  NEW BUSINESS

1.  REORGANIZATION OF MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL, PUBLIC HOUSING AUTHORITY,
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE RDA, AND PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Conduct reorganization.

  Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant II, opened the nominations for the position of Mayor and all
  committees the Mayor serves on such as Public Housing Authority, Successor Agency to the RDA,
  and Public Financing Authority.

  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan nominated Mayor Roa to remain as Mayor for an additional year.

  Councilmember Alvarado made comments in support of Mayor Roa serving an additional year as
  Mayor.

  Councilmember Del Rio made comments in support of Mayor Roa serving an additional year as
  Mayor.

  Councilmember Maravilla made comments in support for Mayor Roa serving as Mayor for an
  additional year and give another Councilmember the opportunity to serve as Mayor Pro Tem.

  Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant II, closed nominations.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Alvarado, to appoint
  Luis Roa as Mayor.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:
  AYES: 5; Farfan, Roa, Alvarado, Maravilla, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;
  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

  Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant II, opened the nominations for the position of Mayor Pro Tem and
  all committees the Mayor Pro Tem serves on such as Public Housing Authority, Successor Agency
  to the RDA, and Public Financing Authority.

  Councilmember Maravilla nominated Councilmember Del Rio for Mayor Pro Tem.

  Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant II, closed nominations.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Maravilla, and seconded by Councilmember Alvarado, to
  appoint Teresa Maria Del Rio as Mayor Pro Tem.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:
  AYES: 5; Farfan, Roa, Alvarado, Maravilla, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;
  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

2.  RECOMMENDATION TO (1) OPT INTO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WITH OPIOID
  DISTRIBUTORS, AMERISOURCE BERGEN, CARDINAL HEALTH, AND MCKESSON,
  WHEREBY THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES WILL RECEIVE THE CITY’S DESIGNATED
  SHARE OF SETTLEMENT FUNDS, AND DIRECT THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE ANY
  DOCUMENTS NECESSARY TO IMPLEMENT THE ACTION. (2) OPT INTO SETTLEMENT
  AGREEMENT WITH OPIOID MANUFACTURER, JANSSEN (OWNED BY JOHNSON &
  JOHNSON), WHEREBY THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES WILL RECEIVE THE CITY’S
  DESIGNATED SHARE OF THE SETTLEMENT FUNDS, AND DIRECT THE CITY MANAGER TO
  EXECUTE ANY DOCUMENTS NECESSARY TO IMPLEMENT THE ACTION.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendations
  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Maravilla, to approve
  Consent Calendar Items.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:
  AYES: 5; Farfan, Roa, Alvarado, Maravilla, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0
C.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Maravilla congratulated Mayor Roa and Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio for serving the
upcoming year, and thanked staff for their hard work and wished everyone Happy Holidays.

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio thanked City Council for the opportunity to serve as Mayor Pro Tem.

Councilmember Alvarado congratulated Mayor Roa and Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio and wished everyone
Happy Holidays.

Councilmember Farfan also congratulated the Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem for their upcoming term and
hopes to continue to work together.

Mayor Roa made comments similar to Councilmember Farfan and wishes to move Hawaiian Gardens
forward.
